transitPathLevel.mathematicalRule: Every Path stage must identify the mathematical/operator capability, changed terms, and physical upgrade drivers that explain its confirmed performance progression.

sharedTransitCapabilityTier.meaning: shared cross-family capability/performance envelope used by the live base FTL generator

pathToSharedTierDefault.resolverRule: When a Path level is explicitly requested, the Path level controls the maturity baseline and resolves/corrects the shared T-tier; family availability may clamp the mapped tier to the selected family's certified runtime window.

scaleSystem.rule: Never merge conventional propulsion P-band, transit Path P-level, or shared transit T-tier into one generic technology level. Preserve their names, source, and coupling provenance.

gravitationalTerrainModel.confirmedPremise: Dark matter is partly the projected cause and partly the projected effect of higher-dimensional gravitational shear structure; these shear bands are the underlying universal terrain for advanced Black Light transit mathematics.
gravitationalTerrainModel.integrationRule: All transit-family mathematical solvers consume the shared terrain state as an environmental/reference input. The family operator remains distinct and controls how terrain affects effective distance, burden, route validity, or reference stability.

canonSafeguards: Never overwrite a confirmed source value with generated content.
Never replace a confirmed lower bound, classification, explicit unknown, or live runtime constraint with an unlabeled procedural value.
Keep candidate or disputed source records separate from confirmed records.
Unknown remains unknown in AUTHORITY_ONLY mode.
DERIVED content requires a traceable rule and parent inputs.
PROPOSED content requires explicit proposal mode and cannot be promoted to canon by repetition.
The live T0-T8 shared capability tier and P0-P6 Path level are distinct; an explicit Path level controls the shared-tier baseline through the live mapping rather than being overwritten by it.
Every Transit Path stage must identify the mathematical/operator capability and physical upgrade drivers that explain its capability change; gross energy alone is not a valid default explanation.

All transit calculations must preserve the author-directed dark-matter/higher-dimensional gravitational-terrain premise and retain terrain model epoch plus uncertainty when terrain inference affects route validity.
The shared gravitational terrain does not replace family-specific drive operators; each family must state how terrain changes its effective distance, burden, route constraints, or reference state.
Black Light dark matter must not be silently reduced to one exclusive real-world particle model, and not all dark matter is required to be exclusively higher-dimensional shear.
Equivalent transit speed is not local hull velocity for nonlocal or discontinuous mechanisms.
The Fold-Jump toroidal control-volume model is DERIVED and must not be mislabeled as confirmed T^3 topology.
A generated vessel instance may become authoritative for that instance only when its authority snapshot, resolver choices, complete scale coordinates, seed, and generator version are retained.
Generated instance authority never silently rewrites setting-wide race, technology, or transit canon.
FTL does not authorize chronology violation or time travel without explicit source authority.
